types.name: Stone Age, Indus and Vedic
types.description: Stone Age sites, Harappan cities and their finds, and the Vedas, Vedangas and Vedic society.

types.name: Buddhism, Jainism and Mahajanapadas
types.description: Buddha and Mahavira, councils, sacred texts, the 16 Mahajanapadas and the rise of Magadha.

types.name: Mauryas to Guptas and Harsha
types.description: Mauryas, Shungas, Satavahanas, Kushanas, Guptas, Harsha, and the ancient books and foreign travellers of these periods.

types.name: South Indian and Deccan kingdoms
types.description: Sangam kingdoms, Pallavas, Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas, Cholas, Palas and Pratiharas, Vijayanagara and Bahmani.

types.name: Delhi Sultanate
types.description: The five Sultanate dynasties, their rulers, reforms, buildings and officers.

types.name: Mughals, Marathas and regional powers
types.description: Mughal emperors, Sher Shah, Shivaji and the Peshwas, and other regional states such as Mysore, Punjab and the Ahoms.

types.name: Bhakti, Sufi and Sikh gurus
types.description: Bhakti saints and their works, Sufi orders and shrines, and the ten Sikh gurus.

types.name: British rule, 1857 and revolts
types.description: European companies, battles of conquest, governors-general, land revenue systems, the Revolt of 1857 and tribal or peasant uprisings.

types.name: Social and religious reform
types.description: 19th and 20th century reformers and the organisations they founded.

types.name: Colonial acts and commissions
types.description: Regulating Act to Indian Independence Act, and British commissions and missions.

types.name: National movement
types.description: Congress and its sessions, moderates and extremists, Gandhian movements, revolutionaries and the INA.

types.name: India after 1947
types.description: Events after independence: integration of states, wars, nuclear tests, Emergency and other landmark years.
